anomalies.observed: In the CAN BUS block, both ground-side pins of each isolated CAN transceiver are connected to the same GND net. This bridges the transceiver’s isolation barrier; the secondary-side supply is also labeled 5V_switched_CAN.
anomalies.expected: For the specified isolated CAN interfaces, the transceiver’s logic-side and bus-side grounds must remain separate, with an appropriately isolated supply for the bus side.

evidence.quote: GND1 GND2; GND; 5V_switched_CAN — CAN BUS block, cm4-robot.kicad_sch, page 1.
two isolated CAN buses (CAN0, CAN1), each driven by its own MCP2515 SPI CAN controller (U8, U9) through an isolated CAN transceiver

anomalies.impact: The shared ground bypasses galvanic isolation on both CAN interfaces, so ground-potential differences and bus-side transients can couple into the logic circuitry instead of being isolated.

parsed.summary: The CAN BUS drawing connects GND1 and GND2 of both isolated transceivers to the same GND net, defeating the isolation required by the specification.
